verses.sloka: हन्यमाने बले तूर्णमन्योन्यं ते महामृधे।सरसीव महाघर्मे सोपक्षीणे बभूवतुः ।। ६.९८.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: hanyamāne bale tūrṇamanyonyaṁ te mahāmṛdhe।sarasīva mahāgharme sopakṣīṇe babhūvatuḥ ।। 6.98.1 ।।

translations.english: In the major conflict, each one destroying the other army, it seemed like the midsummer lakes totally lost its water.
translations.hindi: « इस युद्ध में घायल होने के कारण शुभ लक्षणा से युक्त लक्ष्मण का सारा शरीर रक्तरञ्जित हो गया था। युद्ध में उस इन्द्रज्ञीत का बध कर वे प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: स्वबलस्य विघातेन विरूपाक्षवधेन च।बभूव द्विगुणं क्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।। ६.९८.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: svabalasya vighātena virūpākṣavadhena ca।babhūva dviguṇaṁ kruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 6.98.2 ।।

translations.english: The Lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, became doubly angry by the destruction of his army and fall of Virupaksha.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर बे जाम्बवान्‌ ओर बलवान हनुमान तथा समस्त बानरो को लौटा कर, महातेजस्वी लक्ष्मण जी (युद्ध में घायल हो जाने के कारण)

verses.sloka: प्रक्षीणं तु बलं दृष्ट्वा वध्यमानं वलीमुखैः।बभूवास्य व्यथा युद्धे प्रेक्ष्य दैवविपर्ययम्।उवाच च समीपस्थं महोदरमरिन्दमम् ।। ६.९८.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: prakṣīṇaṁ tu balaṁ dṛṣṭvā vadhyamānaṁ valīmukhaiḥ।babhūvāsya vyathā yuddhe prekṣya daivaviparyayam।uvāca ca samīpasthaṁ mahodaramarindamam ।। 6.98.3 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasa's army was killed by Vanaras and drastically reduced. Seeing the adversary of God's grace, Ravana was agonized on witnessing it.
translations.hindi: हनुमान और विभीषण का सहारा ले, वहाँ पहुँचे, जहाँ सुग्रीबसहदित श्रीरामचन्द्र जी थे

verses.sloka: अस्मिन् काले महाबाहो जयाशा त्वयि मे स्थिता।जहि शत्रुचमूं वीर दर्शयाद्य पराक्रमम् ।। ६.९८.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: asmin kāle mahābāho jayāśā tvayi me sthitā।jahi śatrucamūṁ vīra darśayādya parākramam ।। 6.98.4 ।।

translations.english: And then Ravana spoke to Mahodara who was close by, one who is difficult to encounter, saying " At this time the hope for my victory is centered in you."
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के समीप पहुँच लक्ष्मण जी ने उनको प्रणाम ` कआ ओर वे श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पास खड़े हो गए, मानों इन्द्र के पास उनके छोटे भाई खड़े हों

verses.sloka: भर्तृपिण्डस्य कालो ऽयं निर्देष्टुं साधु युध्यताम् ।। ६.९८.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhartṛpiṇḍasya kālo 'yaṁ nirdeṣṭuṁ sādhu yudhyatām ।। 6.98.5 ।।

translations.english: "O heroic Mahodara! Today, exhibit your valour by destroying the enemy army. Having received my subsistence, this is the time to repay. Fight well in war."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो महोदरः।प्रविवेशारिसेनां तां पतङ्ग इव पावकम् ।। ६.९८.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastathetyuktvā rākṣasendro mahodaraḥ।praviveśārisenāṁ tāṁ pataṅga iva pāvakam ।। 6.98.6 ।।

translations.english: Having spoken like that by the king of Rakshasas, Mahodara entered the army of the enemy like a moth enters fire.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने यह कह कर शोभा बढ़ाने वाले श्रीलक्ष्मए जी का सिर सूँघा और लज्जित होते हुए लक्ष्मण जी को बरजोरी अपनी गोदी में बैठा लिया

verses.sloka: ततः स कदनं चक्रे वानराणां महाबलः।भर्तृवाक्येन तेजस्वी स्वेन वीर्येण चोदितः ।। ६.९८.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa kadanaṁ cakre vānarāṇāṁ mahābalaḥ।bhartṛvākyena tejasvī svena vīryeṇa coditaḥ ।। 6.98.7 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, the mighty and brilliant Mahodara, in obedience to the word of the king, inspired by his own valour, went to fight with Vanaras.
translations.hindi: महापराक्रमी श्री रामचन्द्रजी, लक्ष्मए जी द्वारा मेघनाद का मारा जाना सुन, अत्यन्त हर्षित हो, लक्ष्मण जी से बोले

verses.sloka: वानराश्च महासत्त्वाः प्रगृह्य विपुलाः शिलाः।प्रविश्यारिबलं भीमं जघ्नुस्ते रजनीचरान् ।। ६.९८.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarāśca mahāsattvāḥ pragṛhya vipulāḥ śilāḥ।praviśyāribalaṁ bhīmaṁ jaghnuste rajanīcarān ।। 6.98.8 ।।

translations.english: The mighty Vanaras also seizing huge rocks entered into the frightening enemy army of the Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! तुम धन्य हो ! तुम्हारे इस उत्तम कर्म को देख मैं बड़ा सन्तुष्ट हुआ हूँ । क्योंकि जब इन्द्रजीत मारा जा चुका, तब अपनी जीत ही समकनी चाहिए

verses.sloka: महोदरस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः।चिच्छेद पाणिपादोरून् वानराणां महाहवे ।। ६.९८.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahodarastu saṅkruddhaḥ śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ।ciccheda pāṇipādorūn vānarāṇāṁ mahāhave ।। 6.98.9 ।।

translations.english: In that great war, enraged Mahodara with arrows decked in gold shattered the Vanaras by attacking on hands, legs, and thighs.

verses.sloka: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसैरर्दिता भृशम्।दिशो दश द्रुताः केचित् केचित् सुग्रीवमाश्रिताः ।। ६.९८.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: tataste vānarāḥ sarve rākṣasairarditā bhṛśam।diśo daśa drutāḥ kecit kecit sugrīvamāśritāḥ ।। 6.98.10 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, unable to bear the pain, those Vanaras hit by Rakshasas, went in ten directions and some went to Sugriva for refuge.

verses.sloka: प्रभग्नां समरे दृष्ट्वा वानराणां महाचमूम्।अभिदुद्राव सुग्रीवो महोदरमनन्तरम् ।। ६.९८.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: prabhagnāṁ samare dṛṣṭvā vānarāṇāṁ mahācamūm।abhidudrāva sugrīvo mahodaramanantaram ।। 6.98.11 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the great army of Vanaras defeated in the conflict, Sugriva rushed towards Mahodara.
translations.hindi: बाणों की चोट से पीडित, घाव खाए हुए और हाँफते हुए लक्ष्मण को देख, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी दुःखी और सन्तापित हुए तथा चार बार उसाँसे लेने लगे

verses.sloka: प्रगृह्य विपुलां घोरां महीधरसमां शिलाम्।चिक्षेप च महातेजास्तद्वधाय हरीस्वरः ।। ६.९८.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya vipulāṁ ghorāṁ mahīdharasamāṁ śilām।cikṣepa ca mahātejāstadvadhāya harīsvaraḥ ।। 6.98.12 ।।

translations.english: Endowed with great energy, Sugriva, the monkey Lord, seizing a huge mountain like dreadful rock, hurled to kill Mahodara.
translations.hindi: पुरुषश्रेष्ठ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने पुनः लक्ष्मण का सिर सूँघा और ' वे उनके शरीर पर हाथ फेरते हुए उनको ढाद्स बँधा, उनसे कहने लगे

verses.sloka: तामापतन्तीं सहसा शिलां दृष्ट्वा महोदरः।असम्भ्रान्तस्ततो बाणैर्निर्बिभेद दुरासदाम् ।। ६.९८.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāmāpatantīṁ sahasā śilāṁ dṛṣṭvā mahodaraḥ।asambhrāntastato bāṇairnirbibheda durāsadām ।। 6.98.13 ।।

translations.english: Then seeing the formidable rock coming towards him, he was not bewildered and immediately struck and broke it with his arrows.
translations.hindi: इस दुष्करकमे को कर, तुमने परस कल्याणकारी कमै किआ हे । इन्द्रजीत के मारे जाने से मैं तो समझता हूँ कि, आज युद्ध में रावण मारा गया । अथवा पुत्र के मारे जाने।से रावण को भी मारा हुआ ही में सममता हूँ

verses.sloka: रक्षसा तेन बाणौघैर्निकृत्ता सा सहस्रधा।निपपात शिला भूमौ गृध्रचक्रमिवाकुलम् ।। ६.९८.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: rakṣasā tena bāṇaughairnikṛttā sā sahasradhā।nipapāta śilā bhūmau gṛdhracakramivākulam ।। 6.98.14 ।।

translations.english: That rock, struck by Mahodara fell on the ground shattered and broken into a thousand pieces.

verses.sloka: तां तु भिन्नां शिलां दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।सालमुत्पाट्य चिक्षेप राक्षसे रणमूर्धनि ।। ६.९८.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ tu bhinnāṁ śilāṁ dṛṣṭvā sugrīvaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ।sālamutpāṭya cikṣepa rākṣase raṇamūrdhani ।। 6.98.15 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the fragmented rock, Sugriva was deluded with anger, and tearing up a sala tree, he shattered on the Rakshasa (Mahodara) in the battlefield.

verses.sloka: शरैश्च विददारैनं शूरः परपुरञ्जयः ।। ६.९८.१६ ।।्च्छितः।स ददर्श ततः क्रुद्धः परिघं पतितं भुवि ।। ६.९८.१७ ।।तः।आविध्य तु स तं दीप्तं परिघं तस्य दर्शयन्।परिघाग्रेण वेगेन जघानास्य हयोत्तमान् ।। ६.९८.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: śaraiśca vidadārainaṁ śūraḥ parapurañjayaḥ ।। 6.98.16 ।।्cchitaḥ।sa dadarśa tataḥ kruddhaḥ parighaṁ patitaṁ bhuvi ।। 6.98.17 ।।taḥ।āvidhya tu sa taṁ dīptaṁ parighaṁ tasya darśayan।parighāgreṇa vegena jaghānāsya hayottamān ।। 6.98.18 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara, a scourge of enemy forces, who lacerated Sugriva in that manner, angry, made the tree fall on the ground.

verses.sloka: तस्माद्धतहयाद्वीरः सो ऽवप्लुत्य महारथात्।गदां जग्राह सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसो ऽथ महोदरः ।। ६.९८.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmāddhatahayādvīraḥ so 'vaplutya mahārathāt।gadāṁ jagrāha saṅkruddho rākṣaso 'tha mahodaraḥ ।। 6.98.19 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, picking up that glowing iron bar, exhibiting its top, whirling it around, struck the best of horses of Mahodara.

verses.sloka: गदापरिघहस्तौ तौ युधि वीरौ समीयतुः।नर्दन्तौ गौवृषप्रख्यौ घनाविव सविद्युतौ ।। ६.९८.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: gadāparighahastau tau yudhi vīrau samīyatuḥ।nardantau gauvṛṣaprakhyau ghanāviva savidyutau ।। 6.98.20 ।।

translations.english: Then the hero, Mahodara, his horses destroyed, jumped from the great chariot, and took hold of a mace.

verses.sloka: ततः क्रुद्धो गदां तस्मै चिक्षेप रजनीचरः।ज्वलन्तीं भास्कराभासां सुग्रीवाय महोदरः ।। ६.९८.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddho gadāṁ tasmai cikṣepa rajanīcaraḥ।jvalantīṁ bhāskarābhāsāṁ sugrīvāya mahodaraḥ ।। 6.98.21 ।।

translations.english: Both the heroes, Mahodara and Sugriva like two bulls holding mace and iron bar respectively, like clouds charged with lightning came roaring in the battlefield.

verses.sloka: गदां तां सुमहाघोरामापतन्तीं महाबलः।सुग्रीवो रोषताम्राक्षः समुद्यम्य महाहवे।आजघान गदां तस्य परिघेण हरीश्वरः ।। ६.९८.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: gadāṁ tāṁ sumahāghorāmāpatantīṁ mahābalaḥ।sugrīvo roṣatāmrākṣaḥ samudyamya mahāhave।ājaghāna gadāṁ tasya parigheṇa harīśvaraḥ ।। 6.98.22 ।।

translations.english: Then provoked by anger, the night ranger, Mahodara flung his mace at Sugriva which shone like the Sun.

verses.sloka: पपात स गदोद्भिन्नः परिघस्तस्य भूतले ।। ६.९८.२३ ।।ोषताम्राक्षः समुद्यम्य महाहवे।ततो जग्राह तेजस्वी सुग्रीवो वसुधातलात्।आयसं मुसलं घोरं सर्वतो हेमभूषितम् ।। ६.९८.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: papāta sa gadodbhinnaḥ parighastasya bhūtale ।। 6.98.23 ।।oṣatāmrākṣaḥ samudyamya mahāhave।tato jagrāha tejasvī sugrīvo vasudhātalāt।āyasaṁ musalaṁ ghoraṁ sarvato hemabhūṣitam ।। 6.98.24 ।।

translations.english: In that terrible conflict, seeing the mace broken and falling, mighty Sugriva, whose eyes turned red in anger, lifted up his iron bar, struck at the mace of the Rakshasa. The mace fell on the ground and broke into pieces.

verses.sloka: स तमुद्यम्य चिक्षेप सो ऽप्यन्यां व्याक्षिपद्गदाम्।भिन्नावन्योन्यमासाद्य पेततुर्धरणीतले ।। ६.९८.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tamudyamya cikṣepa so 'pyanyāṁ vyākṣipadgadām।bhinnāvanyonyamāsādya petaturdharaṇītale ।। 6.98.25 ।।

translations.english: In that terrible conflict, seeing the mace broken and falling, mighty Sugriva, whose eyes turned red in anger, lifted up his iron bar, struck at the mace of the Rakshasa. The mace fell on the ground and broke into pieces.

verses.sloka: ततो भग्नप्रहरणौ मुष्टिभ्यां तौ समीयतुः।तेजोबलसमाविष्टौ दीप्ताविव हुताशनौ ।। ६.९८.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato bhagnapraharaṇau muṣṭibhyāṁ tau samīyatuḥ।tejobalasamāviṣṭau dīptāviva hutāśanau ।। 6.98.26 ।।

translations.english: Then, energetic Sugriva picked from the ground a frightening steel club encrusted with gold on all sides.

verses.sloka: जघ्नतुस्तौ तदा ऽन्योन्यं नेदतुश्च पुनःपुनः।तलैश्चान्योन्यमाहत्य पेततुर्धरणीतले ।। ६.९८.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: jaghnatustau tadā 'nyonyaṁ nedatuśca punaḥpunaḥ।talaiścānyonyamāhatya petaturdharaṇītale ।। 6.98.27 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva took up the steel club and hurled at Mahodara who took another mace and hit back. Both collided with each other and shattered they fell down on the surface of the earth.

verses.sloka: उत्पेततुस्ततस्तूर्णं जघ्नतुश्च परस्परम्।भुजैश्चिक्षिपतुर्वीरावन्योन्यमपराजितौ।जग्मतुस्तौ श्रमं वीरौ बाहुयुद्धे परन्तपौ ।। ६.९८.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: utpetatustatastūrṇaṁ jaghnatuśca parasparam।bhujaiścikṣipaturvīrāvanyonyamaparājitau।jagmatustau śramaṁ vīrau bāhuyuddhe parantapau ।। 6.98.28 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, both of them fully endowed with strength, with their weapons broken, who resembled glowing fires, fought with their fists.

verses.sloka: आजहार ततः खड्गमदूरपरिवर्तिनम्।राक्षसश्चर्मणा सार्धं महावेगो महोदरः ।। ६.९८.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ājahāra tataḥ khaḍgamadūraparivartinam।rākṣasaścarmaṇā sārdhaṁ mahāvego mahodaraḥ ।। 6.98.29 ।।

translations.english: Then both of them again and again striking each other slapping with palms fell down and rolled on the ground.

verses.sloka: तथैव च महाखड्गं चर्मणा पतितं सह।जग्राह वानरश्रेष्ठः सुग्रीवो वेगवत्तरः ।। ६.९८.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: tathaiva ca mahākhaḍgaṁ carmaṇā patitaṁ saha।jagrāha vānaraśreṣṭhaḥ sugrīvo vegavattaraḥ ।। 6.98.30 ।।

translations.english: Then quickly getting up striking one another, both the heroes who have never been defeated, pushed each other by their arms.

verses.sloka: तौ तु रोषपरीताङ्गौ नर्दन्तावभ्यधावताम्।उद्यतासी रणे हृष्टौ युधि शस्त्रविशारदौ ।। ६.९८.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau tu roṣaparītāṅgau nardantāvabhyadhāvatām।udyatāsī raṇe hṛṣṭau yudhi śastraviśāradau ।। 6.98.31 ।।

translations.english: Both being scourge of their enemies, both heroes wrestling were exhausted with fighting. Then the Rakshasa picked up a sword lying not far from there along with a shield.

verses.sloka: दक्षिणं मण्डलं चोभौ सुतूर्णं सम्परीयतुः।अन्योन्यमभिसङ्क्रुद्धौ जये प्रणिहितावुभौ ।। ६.९८.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇaṁ maṇḍalaṁ cobhau sutūrṇaṁ samparīyatuḥ।anyonyamabhisaṅkruddhau jaye praṇihitāvubhau ।। 6.98.32 ।।

translations.english: Likewise, Sugriva endowed with speed, a champion of Vanaras, took up a huge sword fallen down with a shield.

verses.sloka: स तु शूरो महावेगो वीर्यश्लाघी महोदरः।महाचर्मणि तं खड्गं पातयामास दुर्मतिः ।। ६.९८.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu śūro mahāvego vīryaślāghī mahodaraḥ।mahācarmaṇi taṁ khaḍgaṁ pātayāmāsa durmatiḥ ।। 6.98.33 ।।

translations.english: Then the two, whose limbs ceased, who were knowledgeable in the use of weapons, furious, sprang forward in the battle, both with joy, roaring to destroy one another.

verses.sloka: लग्नमुत्कर्षतः खड्गं खड्गेन कपिकुञ्जरः।जहार सशिरस्त्राणं कुण्डलोपहितं शिरः ।। ६.९८.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: lagnamutkarṣataḥ khaḍgaṁ khaḍgena kapikuñjaraḥ।jahāra saśirastrāṇaṁ kuṇḍalopahitaṁ śiraḥ ।। 6.98.34 ।।

translations.english: Enraged at one another, intent to win, both stretched forth at great speed, going from left to right in circles and encountered each other.

verses.sloka: निकृत्तशिरसस्तस्य पतितस्य महीतले।तद्बलं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दृष्ट्वा तत्र न तिष्ठते ।। ६.९८.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nikṛttaśirasastasya patitasya mahītale।tadbalaṁ rākṣasendrasya dṛṣṭvā tatra na tiṣṭhate ।। 6.98.35 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara, a warrior, evil minded one, endowed with great speed, hurled the sword on the shield of Sugriva.

verses.sloka: हत्वा तं वानरैः सार्धं ननाद मुदितो हरिः।चुक्रोध च दशग्रीवो बभौ हृष्टश्च राघवः ।। ६.९८.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: hatvā taṁ vānaraiḥ sārdhaṁ nanāda mudito hariḥ।cukrodha ca daśagrīvo babhau hṛṣṭaśca rāghavaḥ ।। 6.98.36 ।।

translations.english: While Mahodara was extracting the sword stuck to the head, Sugriva, the elephant of the monkeys, severed the head of Mahodara which was decked with earrings and helmet.

verses.sloka: विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे राक्षसा दीनचेतसः।विद्रवन्ति ततः सर्वे भयवित्रस्तचेतसः ।। ६.९८.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve rākṣasā dīnacetasaḥ।vidravanti tataḥ sarve bhayavitrastacetasaḥ ।। 6.98.37 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara's head severed and fell on the ground. Seeing that Rakshasa king's army ran from there.

verses.sloka: महोदरं तं विनिपात्य भूमौ महागिरेः कीर्णमिवैकदेशम्।सूर्यात्मजस्तत्र रराज लक्ष्म्या सूर्यः स्वतेजोभिरिवाप्रधृष्यः ।। ६.९८.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahodaraṁ taṁ vinipātya bhūmau mahāgireḥ kīrṇamivaikadeśam।sūryātmajastatra rarāja lakṣmyā sūryaḥ svatejobhirivāpradhṛṣyaḥ ।। 6.98.38 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, the monkey leader having killed Mahodara, the Vanaras shouted in joy. The ten headed Ravana became enraged. Raghava was glad.

verses.sloka: अथ विजयमवाप्य वानरेन्द्रः समरमुखे सुरयक्षसिद्धसङ्घैः।अवनितलगतैश्च भूतसङ्घैर्हरुषसमाकुलितैः स्तुतो महात्मा ।। ६.९८.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha vijayamavāpya vānarendraḥ samaramukhe surayakṣasiddhasaṅghaiḥ।avanitalagataiśca bhūtasaṅghairharuṣasamākulitaiḥ stuto mahātmā ।। 6.98.39 ।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas became dull and piteous with sad faces. Out of fear they ran.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे अष्टनवतितमः सर्गः ।। ९८ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe aṣṭanavatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 98 ।।

translations.english: Just as a part of a huge mountain thrown down, an unassailable Mahodara, fallen on the ground, shone there like Lakshmi, just as the Sun shines by his own radiance.
